checks.rule: The national LIDAR collection identifies a DTM covering approximately 99 percent of England at 1 m spatial resolution.
Composite DTM data can be downloaded as GeoTIFF rasters in 5 km tiles aligned to the OS National Grid.
The Defra service exposes composite DTM download and map/service endpoints including WMS, WCS and WMTS.
Metadata Survey Index catalogue services are available for checking source-survey provenance.
The composite DTM coordinate reference system is EPSG:27700.
The composite DTM is a terrain model rather than a surface-object model.
Use coverage metadata before requesting parcel samples so uncovered areas become NO_DATA rather than inferred elevation.
A service response must be tied to dataset identifier and CRS before numerical elevation values are accepted.
WMS visualization alone is not sufficient numeric evidence for a parcel height-difference row.
Prefer numeric raster or coverage access for measurement while retaining service URL and access time.
Keep the metadata-survey index with each sampled tile so merged-composite provenance remains auditable.
If an official endpoint is unavailable, record source-read failure and continue without fabricating a value.
